g.text: TJ Murphy tag gallery: plan v2 (prototype, issue #251)
Tags are a proposal, not yet approved by TJ.
234 paintings · 12 rooms + entrance hall · 18 doorways · every room has 2+ exits, no dead ends
Cost = sum(sim x hex distance) + walking term: random mean 2491, greedy 1374, annealed 1337 (similarity part 993). Walk to pavilion: mean 27.7 m, max 36.9 m

Fill = proposed wall color (light tint of the room palette; swatches = dominant painting colors). Dashed circle = clear centerpiece zone (ideas are suggestions). Honeycomb: beige strips = 2 m hallways between all cells; brown dots = colonnade columns along courtyard edges (step out between them). Green hex = walkable open-air courtyard: fountain, ring path, paths out to every colonnade, planting beds in the corners. Blue squares = hallway windows looking into courtyards. Ceilings 6 m in rooms, 4.5 m in halls.
Loops: 6 through doorways, 18 counting courtyard routes (+12). Blank room-wall segments: 0 of 102.
Red brackets: tight sets (triptychs one row in order; Burning Man Temple 2022 four as a 2x2 grid). Wall markers: coloured bar = painting frame at true width; grey bar = plaque. ~ = estimated size.
